ModName.English: [Specialist] Captain Mara Voss, Fleet Gunnery Officer

Description.English:
I wanted one warship to be able to carry a fight when the odds were against it. Assign Mara to the ship you want to strengthen, whether that is a lone escort or the flagship of a larger fleet.

Active Healing keeps self-repair running under fire at +500% repair rate. Unwavering raises damage as hull strength falls, up to 1.6 times normal. Adds 1,000 hit points and a local +100% maximum hull bonus.
